name: Lessons register (schema + lint, enforced or named)
summary: a JSON register of lessons learned where every row must say when it applies and WHERE it is enforced (status live, or proposed with a named landing spot — a bare TBD is not a legal row), with a linter that refuses the publish otherwise and reports the unenforced count as a visible clock
retires: the lessons-learned document nobody re-reads, and the retro that produces advice with no owner
